insight: Built by two ex-Shopify engineers; it reached a ~$100M run-rate powering Cursor and Notion having raised under $1M.
name: Turbopuffer
tagline: Object-storage-backed vector DB. Serverless economics at scale.
description: Bills like S3 — cold rest, warm reads, no per-namespace minimums. Designed for very-large, mostly-cold vector workloads where you can't justify keeping every index in RAM. Operated by Notion in production.
edge: Indexes live on object storage, not RAM, so cost tracks usage not corpus size — built for huge, mostly-cold vector workloads.
pros: Scales to very large, cold corpora
